paragraphs: He is mentioned in Berakhot 48a, reporting Rava; Hyman reports the Dikdukei Soferim reading R"H bar Yehudah.[^1]

notes.text: The actual Davidson Berakhot 48a paragraph explicitly names Rav Chana bar Yehudah reporting Rava. The separate Dikdukei Soferim ר"ה occurrence remains R"H in the new body; it is Hyman’s variant report and was not freshly resolved from an apparatus. No name, title, or identity harmonization is admitted.
